title: Token-driven chart theming and modular tooltip adapter for high-performance time-series
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Time-series charts have accrued multiple ad-hoc color and spacing tokens plus several tooltip implementations across the product. That has led to unpredictable contrast/perf outcomes and duplicated DOM-heavy tooltip logic.

Goal: Replace hard-coded chart visuals with a token-driven theme layer and introduce a single modular tooltip adapter that supports lightweight SR summaries, lazy DOM hydration, streaming previews, and a low-cost canvas fallback for high-density series. The design should be implementable by the component library with clear token mappings and a migration path for legacy charts.
acceptance_criteria: Chart components can be themed entirely from design tokens (colors, stroke widths, elevation, spacing) with a documented mapping table.
New modular tooltip adapter is implemented as an opt-in prop for Chart components and supports three hydration modes: immediate, lazy-on-hover, and streaming-preview.
Accessibility: screen-reader friendly summary is emitted via aria-live for hover/focus; tooltips use reduced-motion and high-contrast tokens; components pass an internal a11y checklist.
Performance: time-to-interactive for high-density charts improves by 30% in the benchmark harness (see perf notes).
Migration guide exists: step-by-step for replacing legacy tooltip instances and token overrides with examples and a PR checklist.
design_notes: Token model: introduce chart-specific token namespace: --chart-01-color, --chart-01-stroke, --chart-tooltip-bg, --chart-tooltip-border-radius, --chart-aria-announce-priority.
Theme layering: support semantic tokens (semantic: success/warning/error) and low-level tokens (palette indexes) to allow runtime remapping by engineering for enterprise themes.

Tooltip adapter design: small API surface: {mode: 'immediate' | 'lazy' | 'stream', srSummary: string | callback, contentRenderer: fn}. The adapter emits a concise SR summary to a single aria-live region and returns tooltip DOM only when in lazy or immediate mode.
Hydration strategy: use lightweight DOM placeholders for streaming mode with minimal attributes for hit testing; full DOM injected on stable hover or keyboard focus to minimize main-thread cost.
Canvas fallback: for >250 series or >20k points, suggest an off-main-thread canvas rendering path with caption-only interactive probe to reduce DOM nodes and memory pressure.
Contrast/testing: tie color tokens to accessible contrast constraints and include automated color-pair checks in the tokens repo pipeline.
implementation_tasks: Design: finalize token list and create Figma components with token variants.
Engineering: add token mappings to component library and expose theme hooks to runtime.
Engineering: implement modular tooltip adapter in chart-core package with three hydration modes and SR summary hook.
Research/Infra: extend existing perf harness to include 1k-point and 10k-point synthetic series with typical user traces and collect TTI/TTI-interactive metrics.
QA: create accessibility smoke tests: keyboard nav, screen-reader summary validation, color contrast assertions.
Docs: write migration guide and API doc for new tooltip adapter and token mapping table.
PM: coordinate rollout plan and feature flags for gradual migration of host applications.
